item.title: New Cheaper PS5 Officially Available for Pre-Order Now
item.description: With the cost of a PlayStation 5 going up and up in price since the console's launch in 2020, late adopters are looking at a $599 entry-level price if they want to play Grand Theft Auto 6 on PS5 this November. While the current generation of consoles is bucking the trend that dedicated gaming devices typically go down in price over time — thanks a lot, generative AI speculation! — Sony is offering some small amount of relief to one market with a new PlayStation 5 console that costs around $350.

item.title: Marvel Rivals Officially Brings Avengers: Endgame's Final Fight to Life
item.description: Thanos has his work cut out for him. NetEase just revealed the first gameplay footage of Marvel Rivals ’ new “Path to Doomsday - Avengers: Endgame ” PvE mode, and it features a whopping 50 players taking on the Mad Titan at once. Heroes like Captain America and Iron Man face off against Thanos’ legion, as the big bad swings a massive dual-bladed sword that can instantly kill his foes. The scene loosely recreates the final battle scene in Avengers: Endgame , as the forces of good and evil clash on a desolate landscape next to a destroyed Avengers Tower. In practice, the mode looks a bit like a multiplayer version of Dynasty Warriors.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Star Trek Shakes Up Commander With 2 Bold New Mechanics
item.description: Wizards of the Coast began releasing preconstructed Commander decks each year starting in 2011, but ended the Commander series in 2019. New decks have instead rolled out alongside some of its major Magic: The Gathering set releases. While these decks have provided plenty of powerful cards, they haven’t changed with the format with new keyworded mechanics like Lieutenant , which was added in Commander 2014, or Eminence , which debuted in Commander 2017. That’s changing in November, when the Star Trek Universes Beyond set will add two new Commander-specific mechanics.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Star Trek Officially Adds a New Way to Lose the Game
item.description: The vast majority of Magic: The Gathering games end when one player is reduced to zero life, though some players love to build decks around the more unusual ways to achieve victory. You can empty your opponent’s deck, infect them with poison counters, or try to fulfill the win conditions of cards like Simic Ascendancy or Doctor Doom, Unrivaled . Next month, the Star Trek Universes Beyond set will introduce a whole new way to lose based on one of James T. Kirk’s most famous stories.

item.title: 'Final Fantasy 7 Remake' Leads New Wave of Xbox Game Pass Additions
item.description: Xbox Game Pass subscribers have another batch of games to look forward to as Microsoft expands its subscription library with new releases and older favorites. The latest wave includes everything from supernatural mysteries and online RPGs to a remastered tower-defense classic, with several games arriving for Xbox fans before the end of October.

item.title: Star Wars Is Throwing Its Own Super Bowl, with an Original Cast Member Returning
item.description: If you've ever found yourself watching an NFL game and thought, "This would be so much better with lightsabers and Stormtroopers," then do I have some spectacular news specifically for you. On Tuesday, Disney announced it will broadcast a Star Wars -themed real-time animated telecast of Super Bowl LXI in February.

item.title: Christopher Nolan’s The Prestige Sets Surprise Return to Theaters
item.description: Christopher Nolan has spent the past decade turning original films into major box-office events, from the mind-bending sci-fi thriller Tenet to the Oscar-winning biographical drama Oppenheimer . His latest blockbuster, The Odyssey , has continued that streak, bringing Homer’s ancient epic to theaters this summer.

item.title: 73 Years Later, the Greatest Opening Line in Sci-fi History Is Still an Unbeatable Classic
item.description: Science fiction literature has never been lacking in spellbinding openers. William Gibson's Neuromancer conjures an entire cyberpunk world with its image of a sky “the color of television, tuned to a dead channel,” while Ursula K. Le Guin writes just four words — “There was a wall” — to introduce one of the most important ideas of The Dispossessed . Other authors, like Frank Herbert with Dune and Dan Simmons with Hyperion , take a more novelistic approach, dropping readers into the strange preparations for Paul Atreides' journey to Arrakis or the pilgrims' desperate voyage to the Time Tombs, respectively.

item.title: 'Escape' safe code location in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: The Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 "Escape" safe code is stumping players for two reasons. On one hand, it's possible to find the safe code way before you'll find the actual safe itself, so it's easy to think you've missed it somewhere. On the other hand, if you explore in a different direction, you could miss the safe code entirely, then find the safe without knowing how to open it.
